title: The Fish Express
description: An exuberant great white pelican pedals a turquoise touring bicycle. Its enormous golden bill and pendulous throat pouch carry a blue fish, its wings grasp swept handlebars, and orange webbed feet work opposite pedals. Seven-spoke wheels, a diamond frame, feathered shoulders and a compact kickstand complete this freestanding character sculpture.
